description: Use this when someone asks when to post on Instagram, Facebook or TikTok in Kuala Lumpur, Penang, Johor Bahru, Singapore, Jakarta, Manila, Bangkok, New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, Vancouver, London, Sydney, Melbourne or Dubai (or one of those countries). Returns windows in that city's local time where two large 2026 studies (Sprout Social and Buffer) agree, shows where they disagree instead of picking one, and adds what we measured ourselves (restaurants and cafes in the Suara Restaurant Index, and Suara clients when there are enough posts). Do not use it for other cities, for a specific account's own best time, or to promise results.

category.description: Kind of business, e.g. cafe or salon; optional

city.description: City or country, e.g. Kuala Lumpur, KL, Toronto or Malaysia

platform.description: instagram, facebook or tiktok; optional (all three when left out)

name: best_time_to_post
